en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a grove of large, sprawling, ancient-looking oak trees (possibly cork or holm oak) with thick trunks and abundant foliage. In the foreground, a prominent tree trunk has visible carvings, and the overall scene suggests a park-like or natural setting. The lower margin of the image has some reversed or upside-down text, most prominently 'Brun 5232.'
